title: [Pathfind] Dynamic occupancy is layer-blind — deck traffic blocks the roadbed under the span
description: C++ Pathfinder::updateGoal stamps LAYER cells; ground only at bridge ends. Live update_dynamic_obstacles writes XZ-only masks. Player-visible: units on a bridge jam the road underneath and vice versa.

title: [Overlord/Helix] Portable addon never mirrors host body damage state
description: C++ OverlordContain/HelixContain onBodyDamageStateChange setDamageState on the portable addon. Live addons are booleans only. Player-visible: gattling/bunker/speaker stay pristine while hull is yellow/red.

title: [Overlord/Helix] Cloaked host never stealth-grants its portable addon
description: C++ onContaining receiveGrant(true) when host STEALTHED. Live GPS cloaks only the hull. Player-visible: addon stays visible beside invisible Overlord/Helix.

title: [Team] Team-attached script hooks misfire on live host
description: C++ Team::updateState OnCreate once, OnDestroyed on real last-member death. Live leftover update_state reads empty OBJECT_REGISTRY: OnCreate double-runs, OnDestroyed fires at activation, OnIdle/OnEnemySighted/OnUnitDestroyed never fire. Player-visible: campaign team hooks break both ways.

title: [Physics] getMass never adds contained riders' mass
description: C++ PhysicsBehavior::getMass = m_mass + contain->getContainedItemsMass(). Live physics_get_mass is hull only. Player-visible: loaded Chinook/Humvee tossed as far as empty ones.

title: [Loco/Physics] Ground vehicles never track terrain downhill while marching
description: C++ PhysicsBehavior integrates z every frame and clamps to ground. Live march pins Y. Player-visible: tanks hover at crest height down hills.

title: [Save/SpecialPower] All special-power cooldowns reset on load
description: C++ Player::xfer persists specialPowerReadyTimerList. Live restore clears special_power_cooldowns. Player-visible: quickload after Particle Cannon/Nuke/Scud instantly ready.

title: [Save/Player] Player completed_upgrades never saved
description: C++ Player::xfer persists upgrade masks. Live restore rebuilds completed_upgrades empty. Player-visible: Worker Shoes / Subliminal / Flashbang vanish after load.

title: [Save/Player] Alliances reset on load
description: C++ Player::xfer persists player/team relations. Live restore hardcodes Neutral. Player-visible: 2v2 allies become Neutral; shared radar and team victory break.

title: [Weapon] Splash/residual kills never award kill XP
description: C++ ActiveBody scoreTheKill on every lethal damage. Live direct-fire awards XP; splash/residual appliers mark_object_for_destruction without award_experience.

title: [Cursor] Armed-command cursor never resets to ARROW over opaque HUD
description: C++ InGameUI createMouseoverHint sets ARROW over opaque windows. Live host_resolve_context_cursor_icon has no window branch. Targeting reticle stays over the command bar.

title: [SP] NapalmStrike and DirtyNuke/BlackMarketNuke alias other strike kinds
description: Live superweapon_kind maps NapalmStrike to DaisyCutter and DirtyNuke/BlackMarketNuke to NuclearMissile. C++ OCLSpecialPower uses each power's authored OCL.

title: [Audio] SOUND_PLAY_NAMED and ENABLE/DISABLE_OBJECT_SOUND leftover-only
description: C++ ScriptActions doSoundPlayFromNamed / enable object sound. Live handler has no bridge; crate resolver uses empty registry so named sounds play at origin or not at all.

title: [Pathfind] getMoveAwayFromPath never ported — yield is a velocity nudge
description: C++ getMoveAwayFromPath A* to a legal cell. Live ai_move_away_from_unit dest=pos+dir*step. Units veer into water/buildings.

title: [Pathfind] No aircraft goal map — helicopters stack on one LZ
description: C++ setGoalAircraft + adjustToLandingDestination. Live skips Aircraft occupancy. Chinooks stack on one cell.

title: [Save/BattlePlan] Strategy Center battle plan lost on load
description: C++ Player::xfer persists battlePlanBonuses. Live HostBattlePlanRegistry not in WorldSnapshot.
